summary: The StudentPreCertifications user control manages student certification records via a web UI. It allows viewing, adding, editing, and deleting pre-certification records for a student, subject to permissions and session state. The UI consists of grids and popups, utilizes validation and dropdowns, and interacts with backend data sources. Workflow, validation, permission control, and UI logic are tightly integrated.
purpose: To provide a web interface for managing student pre-certifications, enabling authorized users to view, add, edit, or delete records, and ensuring proper permissions, data validation, and business rules are enforced.

workflows.name: Add Certification
steps: User completes entry fields and submits.
Validation performed; if valid, values assigned.
dsStudentCertification inserts record with StudentID and SessionID.
After insert, redirect to Certifications page.

workflows.name: Edit Certification
steps: FormView uxDetail enters Edit mode and loads record.
Validation performed; if valid, new values assigned.
dsStudentCertification updates record with ID, StudentID, SessionID.
After update, redirect to Certifications page.

workflows.name: Delete Certification
steps: deleteRow function called with StudentCertificationID and SessionID.
After delete, redirect to Certifications page.

workflows.name: Data Binding and Display
steps: Data/row permissions checked; rows/buttons shown or hidden based on UserSession.
Dropdowns populated; values set; add/edit/delete buttons enabled/disabled.

business_rules: Only authorized users (PlacingUser, StudentMaint, QESEdit, ITProvisioning, StudentUser if StaffID == StudentID) may view or edit certifications.
If screen is read-only, edit/delete buttons are disabled and add button is hidden.
Certification records with CertificationCodeID equal to DisclosedRegistrationCodeID are shown for ITProvisioning.
Session and StudentID must be provided for data operations.
validations: FormView submit checks Page.IsValid; if not valid, operation cancelled.
Dropdowns require valid selections (default blank or 0 for new entry).
ValidationSummary control displays field validation feedback.
EffectiveDate and ExpiryDate must conform to date constraints set by MaxDate.
calculations: MaxDate for date fields calculated as DateTime.Now plus Max_Future_Years.
Dropdown values selected and set per data field.
conditions: Anonymous users or unauthorized roles may not see or edit data rows.
ITProvisioning users only see disclosed certification codes.
ReadOnly flag disables certain UI controls.
system_behavior: Popup panels and modal dialogs used for detail entry.
ScriptManager and JavaScript used to manage field-level variables and client-side setup.
Redirection to Certifications page after insert, update, or delete.
dependencies: Data sources: dsStudentCertification, dsStdCertifications, dsStatus, dsExpiryDate.
exceptions: Data rows hidden if no permission.
ObjectDataSourceSelecting cancels if UserSession is null.
content_gaps: No details on UI layout, field types, or complete underlying database schema.
No sample data or explicit field-level validations (regex, min/max values).
No explicit error handling details beyond permission and validation failures.
No workflows for bulk import/export or audit trail.
